[vtc] Add breakoutCallId to VtcParticipant and clear it on room close
Spec (77984ff): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L373: "`breakoutCallId` (String|null): The id of a child breakout-room VTCCall to which a moderator has assigned this participant ... Only moderators set it; non-moderators SHOULD receive `forbidden` ... Default: `null`." L764: "The server removes its id from the parent's `breakoutRoomIds` and resets to `null` any `breakoutCallId` on the parent call's participants that names it."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-types/src/participant.rs:106-152; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/memory.rs:242-262; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/memory.rs:691-705; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/backend.rs:181-184; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs:679-686
Now: VtcParticipant has no breakout_call_id, and the memory backend's ring_participant omits it. Closing a breakout room only removes it from the parent's breakoutRoomIds. The old "update callId to move to breakout" model is gone from the spec, and no code implemented it.
Change: Add `#[serde(default)] pub breakout_call_id: Option<Id>` (serialized as null) to VtcParticipant, and emit it in memory.rs ring_participant. Extend the backend.rs update_object/destroy_object contract and the memory backend so that ending a breakout room nulls every parent-call participant's breakoutCallId that names it. The moderator-only and `breakoutRoomIds`-membership validation belongs to the pending VTCParticipant/set handler.
